_comment: Reviewer pools for auto-assignment on new PRs. Every entry must have collaborator access, otherwise a review cannot be requested from them. Edit this file to change the pools; no workflow change is needed.
_seedCountsComment: Used once, to initialize the assignment-count ledger (the REVIEWER_ASSIGNMENT_LEDGER repository variable) the first time the workflow runs. These are the per-person totals from the one-time assignment of the existing open PRs, so the ledger starts from the real distribution. After initialization the ledger is maintained by the workflow and this map is ignored. A pool member missing from the ledger later (e.g. added to a pool above) starts at the lowest count in their pool.
